The Riverside Reading Room
The Riverside Reading Room occupies a renovated warehouse beside a narrow river. Its high ceiling
and broad windows make the interior feel spacious despite its modest floor area. Shelves stand along
the brick walls, leaving the central space open for group discussions. A quiet corner behind a glass
partition is reserved for individual readers. Unlike the busy market across the river, the reading room
has a calm atmosphere. However, the open central area sometimes becomes noisy during
workshops.

A Hilltop Museum
The Arunika Museum sits on a hill overlooking a fictional coastal town. Its exterior is covered with pale
stone, while its interior combines dark wooden floors and white display panels. A gently sloping ramp
connects the three exhibition levels. The upper gallery contains models of fishing vessels, and the
lower gallery displays ordinary household objects from earlier generations. The roof terrace offers an
unobstructed view of the harbor, although visitors cannot access it during heavy rain.

Secondary schools should consider starting lessons later in the morning. A schedule that allows

Text 3 | School Gardens
School gardens are more than decorative spaces; they can be useful learning environments. By
observing plants over time, students connect scientific concepts with visible changes. Measuring
growth and recording conditions also provide opportunities to practice data collection. In addition,
maintaining a garden requires shared responsibilities, which can develop cooperation. Critics may
argue that gardens occupy space and require maintenance. This concern is reasonable, but a small
garden with a clear care schedule can limit these demands. Therefore, a manageable school garden
can enrich learning without becoming an excessive burden.

questions.passage:
Text 4 | Checking Information Online
Checking information before sharing it online is an essential habit. A misleading post can spread
quickly because readers often respond to an emotional headline before examining its evidence.
Comparing a claim with independent, reliable sources can reveal missing context or factual errors.
Checking the publication date is equally important, since accurate information from years ago may no
longer describe current conditions. Verification takes time, but correcting a widely shared false claim
can require even greater effort. For these reasons, careful checking is a necessary part of responsible
online communication.

Text 4 | Checking Information Online
Checking information before sharing it online is an essential habit. A misleading post can spread
quickly because readers often respond to an emotional headline before examining its evidence.
Comparing a claim with independent, reliable sources can reveal missing context or factual errors.
Checking the publication date is equally important, since accurate information from years ago may no
longer describe current conditions. Verification takes time, but correcting a widely shared false claim
can require even greater effort. For these reasons, careful checking is a necessary part of responsible
online communication.
